subject: [PATCH v2 0/2] Fix deferred_split_isolate() and drop the split workaround

2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch series fixes a bug in the deferred_split_isolate() function, which incorrectly handles frozen folios and leads to wrong results when !folio_try_get() is not caused by folio_put(). The bug was inert in upstream code but was discovered during review of another series. The patches fix the issue by removing the workaround for this behavior from __folio_freeze_and_split_unmapped(), and add fixes and closes tags. The changes were tested in a VM with various tests, including split_huge_page_test, folio_split_race_test, and cow.

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer David (Arm) suggested that the sequence of operations in __folio_unqueue_deferred_split() could be extracted into a local helper function, and offered to do it as a separate cleanup.
reviews.raw_body:
In general,

Acked-by: David Hildenbrand (Arm) <david@kernel.org>

But I do wonder whether this sequence (that also
__folio_unqueue_deferred_split()) performs would deserve a small local helper in
mm/huge_memory.c

Could be done as a separate cleanup.

-- 
Cheers,

David

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (author)
reviews.summary: Author is addressing David's feedback about the handling of PG_partially_mapped in deferred_split_isolate(). The author proposes adding a helper function to clear the stat, but does not confirm whether this will be included in the patch.
